mainEntity.name: What is Google Maps Optimization and why is it important for my business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Maps Optimization, often called Local SEO, is the process of improving your business's visibility within Google Maps search results. It involves optimizing your Google Business Profile, gathering customer reviews, and ensuring consistent business information across the web. This optimization is crucial for local businesses because it helps potential customers find your services when they are searching for local options, driving foot traffic and inquiries. For businesses in competitive markets like New York City or Los Angeles, strong Google Maps visibility can significantly impact customer acquisition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Google Maps Optimization improves your business's visibility in Google Maps search results, helping local customers find you and increasing foot traffic and inquiries.
